 RHOBH Season 16 Cast Reunites for Dorit Kemsley’s Big Night Amid Reports of a Cast Divide
 by Amanda | Nov 15, 2026, 10:39 AM | Too Hot for IG | 0 comments 
 RHOBH season 16 tea! The cast of “The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills” season 16 came together in West Hollywood on November 14 to celebrate Dorit Kemsley’s launch of Maison D’Or. Hosted at Orla Restaurant & Rooftop inside The Sun Rose West Hollywood, the star-studded gathering brought out castmates Kyle Richards, Erika Jayne, Sutton Stracke, Bozoma Saint John, Tracy Tutor, Leah Remini, Kathy Hilton, Jennifer Tilly, and Denise Richards. “The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City” star Meredith Marks also attended. The celebration arrives as Season 16 reportedly nears the end of filming—a season marked by a major cast shake-up featuring newcomers Leah Remini and Tracy Tutor, alongside a multi-episode return from Denise Richards.
